thread:
marco-docs: Opening a small PR for an 'Airgapped key rotation & install playbook'—aim is a concise runnable checklist for operators doing key roll and package sync in fully disconnected sites. Will include quick nftables/YUM/apt mirror examples, HSM PKCS#11 checks, and a tiny conn-checker flow. Ping me if we should split into two pages.

leah-sre: Nice. Keep it one page but with clear anchors (preflight, mirror, rotate, rollback). Add a udev rule snippet for HSM token hotplug and a note about rngd on small VMs.

vik-eng: Also include a short YUM reposync example (people use reposync for RHEL-like distros) and a checksum verification step. For envoy chain, keep the example minimal: simple TLS origination to local HSM proxy.

marco-docs: Draft YUM snippet I plan to use:
```bash
# reposync mirror (rhel/centos)
mkdir -p /opt/offline-mirror/yum
reposync -p /opt/offline-mirror/yum -r base -r extras --download-metadata
createrepo_c /opt/offline-mirror/yum
sha256sum $(find /opt/offline-mirror -type f) > /opt/offline-mirror/SHA256SUMS
```

leah-sre: HSM udev example (add this):
```udev
# 01-hsm.rules
ATTRS{vendor}=="0x1234", ATTRS{product}=="0xabcd", MODE="0660", GROUP="hsm"
```
and a systemd unit example to ensure rngd runs before provisioning:
```ini
[Unit]
Requires=rngd.service
After=rngd.service
```

vik-eng: For the envoy snippet, something reduced:
```yaml
static_resources:
  listeners:
    - name: lt
      address: 0.0.0.0:15001
      filter_chains:
        - filters:
            - name: envoy.filters.network.http_connection_manager
              typed_config: {"@type": \"type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.network.http_connection_manager.v3.HttpConnectionManager\", "stat_prefix": "ingress"}
  clusters:
    - name: hsm_proxy
      connect_timeout: 1s
      type: STATIC
      load_assignment: { cluster_name: hsm_proxy, endpoints: [{ lb_endpoints: [{ endpoint: { address: { socket_address: { address: \"10.0.0.10\", port_value: 8443 }}}}]}]}
```
Note: explain we prefer a 1:1 proxy per HSM in sealed environments.

marco-docs: Conn-checker CLI for offline: `./conn-checker --offline --target 10.0.0.10:8443 --kubeconfig /etc/redwood/kubeconfig` plus a curl test to the local proxy: `curl -vk --resolve hsm.local:8443:10.0.0.10 https://hsm.local:8443/status`

leah-sre: Add troubleshooting rows: "HSM not enumerated" -> check `lsusb`, `udevadm info` -> ensure pkcs11 path set and permissions. "Keywrap failing" -> run `pkcs11-tool --list-slots` and verify vendor middleware.

marco-docs: I'll add a short migration note for customers moving keys: export wrapped blobs, validate unwrap on a staging HSM of same model, then rotate. Include commands: `redwoodctl kms export --wrapped --out keys.tar` and `redwoodctl kms verify --in keys.tar`.

ops-bot: Reminder: please include link to private/connectivity/hsm-quickstart for HSM provisioning and to private/networking/offline-repo for mirror guidelines.

vik-eng: One more: add a line under rollback about ABI incompatibility across different HSM firmware; suggest keeping a vendor compatibility matrix and including vendor support contact snippet.

pr-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4210 by marco-docs — "airgapped-key-rotation-playbook". CI: docs-lint ok, linkcheck flagged one obsolete internal link.

marco-docs: Thanks — will swap the link to private/connectivity/hsm-quickstart and add the udev & rngd notes. Tagging @leah-sre @vik-eng for review. :memo:
